Priya (Finance): Quick postmortem follow-up: who owns the token-count backfill, invoice corrections, and alerting fixes? Short replies pls.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): I can own backfill + corrected counts. Need raw ingress logs + tokenizer map. Plan: dry-run today, final CSV by tomorrow EOD.

Maya (Billing): Ill handle invoice corrections and credit memos. Need Ashwin's CSV by Tue 17:00 PT to meet billing cycle.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ill take alerting/runbook. Adding ingestion-lag alert (>10m) and a pre-apply delta sanity check. PR by Tue.

Leo (Platform): Root cause looks like autoscaler flapping during burst. Short-term: pin metering-api min-replicas=3 and add backpressure. Will open PR today.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-5017 created: "Metering token-count backfill + billing fixes" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): I'll draft customer comms (apology + credit + appendix). Draft due Tue 09:00 PT; Legal will review.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Logs export started to s3://redwood-metering/exports/1876543210-logs.tar.gz. Dry-run cmd: metering-backfill --from 2025-11-10 --to 2025-11-12 --dry-run --out deltas.csv

Sam (Eng-SRE): Proposed maintenance window Wed 00:30-01:30 UTC. I'll be on-call for apply and monitor latency + delta anomalies.

Maya (Billing): Preliminary credit est. ~$8.6k across two customers. Holding until Ashwin confirms.

Priya (Finance): Action summary for tracker: Ashwin = backfill + final counts (target Wed EOD), Sam = alerts/runbook (PR Tue), Leo = infra PR (Mon), Maya = invoices + comms (Tue COB). I'll update the postmortem doc and ping execs once numbers final.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-5017 check-in in 48h.
